mapper.select: select t.fileUuid as fileUuid, sum(t.cnt) as total from ( select je.value as fileUuid, count(*) as cnt from adi_draw d, jsonb_array_elements_text( case when jsonb_typeof(d.dynamic_params -> 'ref_image_uuids') = 'array' then d.dynamic_params -> 'ref_image_uuids' else '[]'::jsonb end) je where d.is_deleted = false and je.value in #{uuid} group by je.value union all select u.uuid as fileUuid, count(*) as cnt from adi_draw d, unnest(string_to_array(d.generated_images, ',')) u(uuid) where d.is_deleted = false and d.generated_images <> '' and u.uuid in #{uuid} group by u.uuid union all select d.original_image as fileUuid, count(*) as cnt from adi_draw d where d.is_deleted = false and d.original_image <> '' and d.original_image in #{uuid} group by d.original_image union all select d.mask_image as fileUuid, count(*) as cnt from adi_draw d where d.is_deleted = false and d.mask_image <> '' and d.mask_image in #{uuid} group by d.mask_image union all select u.uuid as fileUuid, count(*) as cnt from adi_character_message m, unnest(string_to_array(m.attachments, ',')) u(uuid) where m.is_deleted = false and m.attachments <> '' and u.uuid in #{uuid} group by u.uuid union all select m.audio_uuid as fileUuid, count(*) as cnt from adi_character_message m where m.is_deleted = false and m.audio_uuid <> '' and m.audio_uuid in #{uuid} group by m.audio_uuid union all select s.fileUuid as fileUuid, count(*) as cnt from ( select case when fe.value like 'http%' or fe.value like '/file/%' then regexp_replace(regexp_replace(fe.value, '^.*/', ''), '\.[^.]+$', '') else fe.value end as fileUuid from adi_workflow_runtime wr, jsonb_each(wr.input) e, jsonb_array_elements_text( case when e.value ->> 'type' = '4' and jsonb_typeof(e.value -> 'value') = 'array' then e.value -> 'value' else '[]'::jsonb end) fe where wr.is_deleted = false and wr.input is not null and jsonb_typeof(wr.input) = 'object' ) s where s.fileUuid in #{uuid} group by s.fileUuid union all select s.fileUuid as fileUuid, count(*) as cnt from ( select case when fe.value like 'http%' or fe.value like '/file/%' then regexp_replace(regexp_replace(fe.value, '^.*/', ''), '\.[^.]+$', '') else fe.value end as fileUuid from adi_workflow_runtime wr, jsonb_each(wr."output") e, jsonb_array_elements_text( case when e.value ->> 'type' = '4' and jsonb_typeof(e.value -> 'value') = 'array' then e.value -> 'value' else '[]'::jsonb end) fe where wr.is_deleted = false and wr."output" is not null and jsonb_typeof(wr."output") = 'object' ) s where s.fileUuid in #{uuid} group by s.fileUuid union all select s.fileUuid as fileUuid, count(*) as cnt from ( select case when fe.value like 'http%' or fe.value like '/file/%' then regexp_replace(regexp_replace(fe.value, '^.*/', ''), '\.[^.]+$', '') else fe.value end as fileUuid from adi_workflow_runtime_node n, jsonb_each(n.input) e, jsonb_array_elements_text( case when e.value ->> 'type' = '4' and jsonb_typeof(e.value -> 'value') = 'array' then e.value -> 'value' else '[]'::jsonb end) fe where n.is_deleted = false and n.input is not null and jsonb_typeof(n.input) = 'object' and exists (select 1 from adi_workflow_runtime wr where wr.id = n.workflow_runtime_id and wr.is_deleted = false) ) s where s.fileUuid in #{uuid} group by s.fileUuid union all select s.fileUuid as fileUuid, count(*) as cnt from ( select case when fe.value like 'http%' or fe.value like '/file/%' then regexp_replace(regexp_replace(fe.value, '^.*/', ''), '\.[^.]+$', '') else fe.value end as fileUuid from adi_workflow_runtime_node n, jsonb_each(n."output") e, jsonb_array_elements_text( case when e.value ->> 'type' = '4' and jsonb_typeof(e.value -> 'value') = 'array' then e.value -> 'value' else '[]'::jsonb end) fe where n.is_deleted = false and n."output" is not null and jsonb_typeof(n."output") = 'object' and exists (select 1 from adi_workflow_runtime wr where wr.id = n.workflow_runtime_id and wr.is_deleted = false) ) s where s.fileUuid in #{uuid} group by s.fileUuid union all select f.uuid as fileUuid, count(*) as cnt from adi_document kd join adi_file f on f.id = kd.source_file_id where kd.is_deleted = false and kd.source_file_id is not null and f.uuid in #{uuid} group by f.uuid union all select f.uuid as fileUuid, count(*) as cnt from adi_knowledge_base_message kbm join adi_file f on (f.id::text = ANY(string_to_array(kbm.source_file_ids, ',')) or f.uuid = ANY(string_to_array(kbm.source_file_ids, ','))) where kbm.is_deleted = false and kbm.source_file_ids <> '' and f.uuid in #{uuid} group by f.uuid ) t group by t.fileUuid
mapper.update: update adi_file set is_deleted = true where id = #{id} and is_deleted = false
